name: Constant Distance Sampling
aliases: Blasi et al. constant distance sampling
Blasi et al. constant distance sampling (single medium)
Monte Carlo light tracing with constant step
definition: Methods to deal with participating media by using a simulation of the particle model of light (Monte Carlo light tracing). First method deals with a single participating medium.
summary: Constant Distance Sampling is a Monte Carlo light tracing technique that advances light bundles in fixed steps, restricting scattering to discrete distances to simplify traversal at the cost of deterministic bias.
